description: Look up one congressional bill from congress.gov (the Library of Congress's official API) by its real-world identifier — congress number, bill type and bill number, e.g. the 118th Congress H.R. 1. Returns title, sponsor, current status (congress.gov's free-text `latestAction`) with its date, introduced date, whether/which law it became, and the congress.gov link. Does NOT return bill text, cosponsors, committee assignments or vote history. Requires an API key: a free api.data.gov key works — supplied automatically when called through the Pipeworx gateway.

bill_type.description: Bill type: hr, s, hres, sres, hjres, sjres, hconres or sconres (congress.gov's own short codes). The long GovTrack-era forms (house_bill, senate_bill, ...) and 'h.r.' are also accepted.

number.description: Bill number within that congress, e.g. 1 for H.R. 1

name: get_bill
